items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I like to think of Ralph Gleason and Gene Williams and Rudy Blesh and people like that, began to reach out to do more.

ctx.x: Just rehearsed and made the date. So into this scene the collectors, especially the Jazz Information, because I like to think of Ralph Gleason and Gene Williams and Rudy Blesh and people like that, began to reach out to do more. And that's how they bought -- they found Bunk Johnson and brought him to New York. And that's a story. I mean, they dug him up and they got him store teeth. And this has been told. And they got him a trumpet. And they handpicked the band for him. And I think he had something to say about…
